title: The hands that are shaping Amaravati
content: As Andhra Pradesh’s greenfield capital takes shape, stories of migrant workers, women finding new livelihoods, and efforts to balance development with social and environmental concerns reveal the human side of building a new city. Their experiences shed a unique light on how an ambitious project is reshaping lives alongside the landscape of the capital region, writes P. Sujatha Varma

title: Karnataka’s rice bowl shows no signs of filling up
content: Deficit rain recorded in June and July because of El-Nino, impact of the West Asia war and some local factors in the rice growing areas have all pushed the price of various rice varieties, writes Rashmi Patil

title: In Telangana, property owners locked out of their own land
content: Several owners of legally purchased plots, houses and apartments across Telangana are finding themselves unable to sell, mortgage or transfer their properties after entire survey numbers containing prohibited categories such as Bhoodan, waqf, ceiling surplus and assigned lands were brought under the Section 22A prohibited list. But the Congress-led government says not one cent of land has been deliberately added to the list since it assumed office in December 2023. P. Laxma Reddy and M. Rajeev explore the ground situation

content: During the search operations, various incriminating documents about immovable property, bank account details, agreements, investment details, list of investors, etc were recovered and seized, which are being scrutinised to proceed further under the provisions of PMLA, 2002.

title: Bengal BJP fights against its ‘Trinamoolification’

content: Justice Veerappa told The Hindu that he found several violations of guidelines with respect to core zone, buffer zone and periphery zone owing to the allowance of commercial activities and homestays in the prohibited area of the Hampi World Heritage Area.

title: Nagpur rape accused in ICU, survivor battles scars in general ward of same hospital
content: A 19-year-old Thane youth was moved to the ICU after complaining of health issues. He is accused of holding a teenage girl captive and sexually torturing her. The survivor underwent plastic surgery for deep wounds inflicted by a surgical blade. Police are seeking cyber experts to unlock seized mobile phones for clues. The accused demanded VIP treatment and refused to cooperate with the investigation.

title: Watch: Accident victim's fractured leg tied with carton at Bihar Hospital
content: A victim of a road accident was treated in a startling manner at the Manjhaul Sub-Divisional Hospital, located in Begusarai, Bihar, where a medicine carton served as a splint. Hospital officials attributed this alarming method to insufficient resources and personnel. The incident gained significant online attention after a video surfaced, prompting a wave of indignation. Consequently, a civil surgeon's investigation into the reported medical malpractice has been initiated.

title: Newly elected PoK legislator is on police bail in UK for child sex offences
content: A former PoK minister faces child sex offense allegations from the 1990s.  He was arrested in the UK and is currently out on police bail.  Ahmed allegedly failed to attend a court date, campaigning instead in Mirpur.  A UK judge allowed him to travel to Pakistan despite his bail status.  Greater Manchester police may seek his extradition if he fails to appear.

title: Watch: Fans used to dry up damaged portion of Rs 4,200cr Lucknow-Kanpur Expressway
content: A contractor is using fans to dry damaged sections of the Lucknow-Kanpur expressway.  This method was employed after heavy rains delayed repair work on the newly inaugurated road.  Photographs of the fans went viral, drawing criticism and public ridicule online.  The damaged stretch has caused significant traffic congestion and delays for commuters.  Authorities have directed the contractor to repair the damage at their own expense.

title: Amazon documentary ‘Melania' that it spent $35m promoting, lost millions after release
content: Melania Trump received a significant licensing fee from a documentary about her life. Amazon MGM Studios acquired and marketed the film for a substantial sum. The documentary's box office earnings were considerably lower than its production costs. However, the film reportedly performed well on Prime Video after its theatrical release. This deal has drawn political scrutiny and accusations of seeking influence.

title: Shubman Gill suffers finger injury, KL Rahul leads India in warm-up game
content: During practice, Shubman Gill, India’s Test captain, suffered a finger injury, prompting the team to rest him on the first day of the warm-up match for safety. In his stead, KL Rahul is taking charge of the squad. With the Test series looming, there is growing concern about Gill's fitness, and the management is monitoring his recovery closely.

title: Rupee slips to 95.28 against US dollar as oil, treasury yields remain elevated
content: On Friday, the Indian rupee experienced a decrease of six paise against the US dollar. Factors such as a robust dollar, escalating US Treasury yields, and elevated dollar demand from importers contributed to this decline. Additionally, rising global oil prices, combined with geopolitical tensions, are projected to impact the rupee further. The domestic market mirrored this trend, as foreign investors recorded net sales.

title: US turns radioactive tank waste into 4.2 metric tons of glass daily
content: During the Cold War, the Hanford Site was vital to the U.S. nuclear program, generating plutonium but also creating a daunting legacy of hazardous radioactive waste—millions of gallons of it. Vitrification is at the heart of the solution, as it transforms this hazardous material into glass for safer long-term storage. The Vit Plant has started processing actual nuclear waste and aims for consistent glass production.

title: Zohran Mamdani tells Amazon, Walmart and 40 others: Stop selling these devices
content: In a bold move to safeguard the community, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has mandated that online retailers cease the sale of illegal high-speed e-bikes, aiming to improve public safety and reduce tragic incidents. Additionally, the mayor has suggested launching five city-funded grocery stores throughout the city, which would provide essential goods at significantly reduced prices, ensuring that average New Yorkers benefit from substantial savings each year.

title: Assam flood toll rises to 97; over 1.68 lakh affected, 481 villages submerged
content: The flood crisis in Assam has reached alarming levels, with 97 fatalities reported. More than 1.68 lakh individuals are struggling across fifteen districts, particularly in Golaghat, where close to 54,000 inhabitants have been affected. The flooding has submerged 481 villages and severely damaged vital agricultural land. In response to this disaster, Jharkhand has pledged Rs 3 crore to the Chief Minister's Relief Fund to aid recovery.

title: Trump angry over leak of US weapons shortage as Iran talks enter crucial phase
content: President Trump expresses frustration over media claims regarding the depletion of US weapons stockpiles, fearing the leaks may undermine America's leverage in negotiations with Iran. While he admits some reports accurately reflect a tighter supply of advanced munitions, he aims to pursue severe penalties for those behind the information leaks. Vice President Vance characterizes negotiating with Iran as exceptionally challenging, referring to their people as radical.

title: Will you have to pay to use UPI? FM Sitharaman clarifies who bears MDR
content: In a recent statement, Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman emphasized that UPI transaction charges will be applicable to merchants rather than customers. She explained that any Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) imposed would be instrumental in enhancing the digital payment ecosystem. Following the passage of an amendment bill in Parliament, a committee will investigate the adjustments to the zero-MDR policy for digital payments.

title: On the frontlines: How Indian sailors are paying the price in Middle East war
content: India's maritime workers are confronting unprecedented challenges as wartime conflicts reconfigure shipping routes into perilous zones. The recent loss of life among Indian sailors in attacks on commercial vessels has raised alarm. With many enduring extended time away from home and facing harsh conditions at sea, their families live in constant worry about their safety. The call for better protection and governmental assistance for these seafarers is intensifying.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: After ten years of service, The Primary School, co-founded by Priscilla Chan, will conclude its operations in June. This institution, known for offering tuition-free education and extensive family support, struggled to achieve state-average academic results despite receiving generous funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. The Initiative has decided to redirect its philanthropic priorities towards funding scientific research instead.

title: India a step closer to procure 114 Rafale fighters as Dassault submits its proposal
content: Dassault Aviation submitted its proposal for 114 Rafale fighter jets to India.  This acquisition will significantly expand India's combat aircraft fleet and deepen cooperation.  The deal includes local production and extensive technology transfer under an intergovernmental agreement.  India seeks 18 fly-away aircraft and 96 to be assembled domestically.  This acquisition will raise India's Rafale strength to 176 aircraft.

title: India's search for answers to rediscover lost glory in Tests begins in Colombo
content: India begin their three-day warm-up fixture against Sri Lanka XI at the NCC in Colombo today. The Shubman Gill-led unit has already had two intense training sessions and a largely rested squad means the team feels fresh for the crucial series starting August 15. There are some injury concerns: Jasprit Bumrah, Washington Sundar, and Sai Sudharsan. However, the squad has enough quality to secure a scoreline that keeps their World Test Championship final chances alive.

title: Fake IDs, dual lives & a dramatic escape: The 28-yr saga of killer Rajinder Bairagi
content: The Delhi Police successfully arrested Rajinder Bairagi, a long-sought fugitive connected to a 1998 murder case. For nearly thirty years, he managed to evade law enforcement by living under a false identity in Madhya Pradesh. During the investigation, authorities also resolved two previously unsolved attempted murder cases from 1997 using leads tied to him. His elaborate disguise was ultimately dismantled following comprehensive surveillance operations.

title: If asked whom to believe, I’ll say Gen Z: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat
content: Mohan Bhagwat advocated for system correction through protests and increased education budgets. He opposed social media bans and favored dialogue with Pakistan and China. Traditional family structures should be upheld while creating space for same-sex relationships. Bhagwat explained women's independence from the RSS apex decision-making body. Societal disrespect for manual labor causes competition for government jobs, he stated.

title: Bumrah told to take a break; selectors urged to recall Shami, Bhuvneshwar
content: Mohammed Shami impressed for Bengal in the Ranji Trophy last season, taking 37 wickets, while Bhuvneshwar Kumar claimed 28 wickets during Royal Challengers Bengaluru's IPL 2026 title-winning campaign.

title: Oil prices rise 1% as Middle East conflict continues Hormuz shipping disruption
content: On Friday, oil prices experienced a modest rise amid shipping uncertainties in the Strait of Hormuz. Traders exhibit caution regarding transit through this critical route. Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump hinted at a potential resolution to the ongoing conflict. Additionally, Iran and Oman are exploring new transit options for the waterway. As developments unfolded, market trends reversed previous declines.

title: 'I was India's 12th man for two years': Ajinkya Rahane reveals
content: Ajinkya Rahane, who recently announced his retirement from all forms of cricket, scored 5,077 runs in 85 Tests at an average of 38.46, including 12 centuries and 26 half-centuries. He also played 90 ODIs, scoring 2962 runs at an average of 35.26, including 3 hundreds and 24 fifties. He also featured in 20 T20Is for India.

title: Hyderabad YouTuber Abhinav Reddy engaged to German traveller Safira
content: A chance meeting between Indian YouTuber Abhinav Reddy, popularly known as Abhi Honey, and German traveller Safira during a trip to Bali has turned into a heartwarming cross-cultural love story that is now captivating millions on social media. What began as a casual friendship soon grew stronger, eventually leading Safira to invite Reddy to her childhood village in Germany.

title: Rahul Gandhi ignored offer to end my fast, says Sonam Wangchuk
content: Sonam Wangchuk voiced disappointment with political leaders after his hunger strike concluded. His wife Gitanjali sought Rahul Gandhi's involvement but received no positive response. Union ministers also reportedly broke a promise regarding the release of photos. Wangchuk felt leaders showed a narrow approach and arrived late to his protest. He praised the apolitical CJP organization for its fair and just advocacy.

title: Aryna Sabalenka, Jessica Pegula back WTA’s new gender testing rule
content: In a significant move, the WTA has enacted a new policy requiring all players to undergo a one-time SRY gene test for eligibility. Aryna Sabalenka, currently the top-ranked player, champions this measure as a means of ensuring fairness in the sport. However, Jessica Pegula, a member of the players' council, perceives it as a bureaucratic tweak with little resistance, reflecting a range of sentiments among players regarding the policy.

title: NBA trade rumor: Heat eye $48M Pistons star to help Giannis Antetokounmpo
content: Miami Heat are reportedly exploring a trade to reunite with sharpshooter Duncan Robinson, sending Nikola Jovic and two second-round picks to Detroit in return. The move would pair Robinson's 41 percent three-point shooting with Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo, addressing a spacing gap left after Miami's offseason moves. Robinson's $15.99 million cap hit lines up closely with Jovic's, making the framework financially realistic for both sides.

title: UPI charges: Lok Sabha passes Bill for government to make changes
content: The Lok Sabha has taken a vital step by passing a Bill aimed at simplifying tax rules to enhance investment attractiveness. The new legislation abolishes a limitation on specific electronic payment options, allowing banks and providers to charge merchants on transactions. Additionally, the government is empowered to revise the zero-MDR scheme for UPI and RuPay. This initiative is poised to drive advancements in the financial sector’s infrastructure and innovative capabilities.

title: SC dismisses plea challenging Delhi HC relief to Hinduja brothers in Bofors case
content: The Supreme Court has officially closed the chapter on the Bofors payoff case by dismissing an appeal that challenged the Delhi high court's 2005 ruling, which had previously annulled criminal proceedings against the Hinduja brothers. Advocate Ajay K Agrawal filed the appeal, but the court decided against allowing more time for arguments, finalizing the legal dispute once and for all.

title: Rain threat looms large over IND vs SL three-day warm-up match
content: India's preparations for the two-Test series against Sri Lanka could be affected by rain, with wet weather forecast in Colombo during the three-day warm-up match against Sri Lanka XI. Heavy showers are expected from Friday morning to Sunday afternoon, raising doubts over how much playing time both teams will get before the first Test in Galle.

title: Netanyahu calls PM Modi, discusses bilateral ties, West Asia situation
content: In a significant phone discussion, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu evaluated the progress made in their strategic partnership and bilateral engagements. They also addressed current developments in West Asia, amidst Israel's increasing international scrutiny due to its military actions. This exchange highlights their continued efforts to bolster cooperation and deepen ties between India and Israel.

title: 'It will end pretty soon': Trump hints at early resolution to US-Iran war
content: Expressing confidence, US President Trump suggested that the Iran conflict is nearing its end, arguing that Tehran cannot bear its continuation. He remains hopeful about negotiations related to the Strait of Hormuz. The US is resolute in preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons. Meanwhile, Iran's defence minister asserts that their military is on standby for any potential threats, and the parliament speaker claims that the US.

title: Jana Nayagan day 15: Thalapathy Vijay film grosses Rs 308.67 crore worldwide
content: Jana Nayagan's box office collections saw a decline on its fifteenth day. The film has now surpassed Rs 300 crore in worldwide gross collections. Its India net collection reached Rs 185.15 crore after fifteen days. Tamil Nadu remained the strongest market, contributing significantly to daily earnings. The movie's performance reflects Vijay's enduring star power.

title: Rahane snubs MS Dhoni, Virat Kohli; names India's greatest-ever cricketer
content: Ajinkya Rahane recently retired from all cricket formats. He named Sachin Tendulkar as India's greatest-ever cricketer. Tendulkar had a remarkable 24-year international career for India. Rahane played alongside Tendulkar in domestic and IPL matches. He also captained India in all three formats.

title: Bombay high court overturns Tejpal acquittal, awards 10-year jail term
content: The Bombay High Court convicted Tarun Tejpal of rape after overturning his acquittal.He received a ten-year rigorous imprisonment sentence for the elevator assault.The court found the survivor's statements truthful and the prosecution's case proven.Tejpal was granted four weeks to surrender after the conviction.This ruling reversed a prior trial court judgment which had acquitted him.

content: The shooting occurred on Friday at a high school in Thailand's Nonthaburi province, where several injuries were reported.

content: Iran has said a deal with Oman to reopen the Strait of Hormuz is "on the verge of being finalised" after both countries confirmed they had agreed on coordinates for shipping routes through the critical waterway.

content: Gangster Atiq Ahmed's son Abaan Ahmed was killed after a car he was travelling by crashed into divider in Uttar Pradesh's Jhansi.

content: Some of the savings touted by Elon Musk's Department of Government Efficiency are incorrect or lack supporting evidence, according to federal auditors.
